decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (SK3a and SK4A received 24/11/2011; Phase 1 Contamination Report received 17/05/2011; and drawings C4, C5 and C7 received 17/05/2011) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - a.	The applicant supplied a Phase 1 land contamination report on 17 May 2011 that indicated an initial assessment that no site decontamination measures are required.
During the course of the development:
b.	The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination submitted on 17 May 2011 in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.  
Before the development is first brought into use:
b.	c	A scheme for decontamination to supersede the contents of the report referred to in clause a) above, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.
Reason: Contamination is known or suspected on the site due to a former land use.  The LPA therefore wishes to ensure that the development can be implemented and occupied with adequate regard for public and environmental safety.
d.	We request that site investigation reports or site plans be sent electronically to landquality@hounslow.gov.uk  or by post on a cd or dvd wherever possible.

Condition : 4 - Before the development hereby permitted is first brought into use, the premises shall be laid out to ensure that visitors to the site, including people using the new retail facility, access, exit and use the forecourt in as safe a manner as possible bearing in mind other forecourt users, the users of neighbouring premises and the adjoining highways, including signage, forecourt surface directions and designated parking bays in accordance with the details submitted to and subsequently approved by the local planning authority under application reference 00505/1/P21(3,4,5,7) as shown in drawing C4 received 17/05/2011. The approved arrangements shall be fully implemented and maintained permanently

Condition : 5 - The premises shall be designed and laid out to be accessible for people with disabilities in accordance with the details submitted to and subsequently approved by the local planning authority under application reference 00505/1/P21(3,4,5,7) as shown in drawing C5 received 17/05/2011.  The approved arrangements shall be fully implemented and maintained permanently
Condition : 6 - The first floor storage and offices areas shall be ancillary to the ground floor retail unit and petrol filling station and not be used as separate office or storage units.

Condition : 7 - Before the development is completed, measures for the harvesting of rainwater, the minimisation of water run-off from the building and the conservation and re-use as appropriate of other water supplies in the building shall be implemented in accordance with the details submitted to and subsequently approved by the local planning authority under application reference 00505/1/P21 (3,4,5,7) as shown in drawing C7 received 17/05/2011.  The approved arrangements shall be fully implemented and maintained permanently.
Condition : 8 - All boilers installed shall be low NOx boilers, conforming to at least NOx class 3 or better.
description: Variation of Condition 2 of planning permission 00505/1/P21 for the construction of a two storey forecourt building attached to the garage dated 21/12/2010 to allow alterations to internal layout and external fenestration
